family.description: Kei1 is a subunit of Saccharomyces cerevisiae inositol phosphorylceramide (IPC) synthase [[cite:PUB00092487]]. It is localised to the Golgi and is cleaved by the late Golgi processing endopeptidase Kex2 [[cite:PUB00092487]]. Kei1 is essential for both the activity and the Golgi localization of IPC synthase [[cite:PUB00092487]].
family.name: Inositolphosphorylceramide synthase subunit Kei1
